summary: Frontend-only regression PASS at https://smart-matrix-hub.preview.emergentagent.com (viewport 390x844). NEW Weather 'Active Alerts' panel powered by api.weather.gov works correctly in all 3 review-request scenarios and does NOT regress prior functionality. (1) NO-ZIP FRESH STATE: with localStorage cleared, the Weather tab renders normally — the master 'Weather Alerts' toggle is present, the ZIP prompt card 'Set your ZIP on the Flights tab to enable alerts.' shows, and NEITHER the 'Active Alerts' section NOR the 'No active alerts' line appears (matches `{located && ...}` guards). No crash, no console errors. (2) ZIP 77002 (Houston, TX): after entering ZIP on Flights tab (geocoded to 'Houston, TX · 29.759, -95.359'), switching to Weather shows the 'Active Alerts' SectionLabel followed by an alert card with a yellow left accent bar, warning icon, event name 'Heat Advisory', a 'Moderate' severity chip, area line 'Houston, Trinity +31 more', and expiry 'until Tue 7:00 AM'. This panel is positioned ABOVE the 'Weather Alerts' master toggle (visible in screenshot /tmp/w_77002.png). (3) ZIP 94103 (San Francisco, CA): compact 'No active alerts for your area.' line renders with green checkmark icon ABOVE the master toggle — no alert cards (verified in /tmp/w_clear_state.png). (4) ZIP 90001 (Los Angeles, CA): shows TWO alert cards — 'Extreme Heat Warning' (orange/Severe chip + orange accent bar) and 'Heat Advisory' (yellow/Moderate chip + yellow accent bar), both with 'Catalina and Santa Barbara Islands, Santa Barbara County Southwestern Coast +7 more' and 'until Tue 5:00 PM' — all above the master toggle (screenshot /tmp/w_90001_final.png). Severity ordering (Severe > Moderate) is correct per SEV_RANK sort. Location line 'Alerts for Los Angeles, CA' appears below the master toggle. (5) REGRESSION: 'Minimum Severity' radio cards select and persist ('severity':'extreme' confirmed in localStorage aura_settings_v1 after tapping Extreme). 'Preview Alert on Matrix' shows the exact info toast 'Connect to the matrix first (Device tab).' when disconnected. All 4 tabs (Device/Flights/Sports/Weather) load with no red-screen. Live NWS fetch via api.weather.gov responds under 8s in the web preview (CORS-enabled, keyless). Auto-refresh interval is wired via setInterval(60_000) with cleanup on unmount; fetchIdRef guards against late/stale responses. No pageerrors, no new deprecation warnings beyond long-standing shadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver notes carried over from iter 8-13.

issues: The Hero title text 'WEATHER ALERTS' shares the same string as the master toggle 'Weather Alerts' label. That is only a test-script hazard (two matches for get_by_text('Weather Alerts')), not a user-facing bug. Suggested testIDs on Weather: weather-hero-title, weather-master-toggle, weather-active-alerts-section, weather-no-alerts-line, weather-alert-card, weather-preview-btn, weather-severity-<id>-radio.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow. Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/SyncFab.tsx and shared Card component.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/SyncFab.tsx.
'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported...' fires when Toast animates. Could be gated behind Platform.OS !== 'web'. Non-blocking. Reference: Toast component.

action_items: (Repeated from iter 8-13) Add testID props to interactive elements. On Weather: weather-master-toggle, weather-active-alerts-section, weather-alert-card, weather-preview-btn. On Flights: flights-zip-input, flights-follow-toggle, flights-callsign-input.
(Repeated) Migrate shadow* -> boxShadow and pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents in SyncFab.tsx.

(Minor, optional) In WeatherScreen `loadAlerts`, on ZIP change, briefly clearing `alerts` state at the top of a new fetch would make the transition from an old ZIP's alerts to a new ZIP's clear-state feel snappier (currently the old cards stay visible until the new fetch resolves). Not a bug — the fetchIdRef guard prevents stale writes.
critical_code_review_comments: weather.ts:41-80 activeAlerts() uses AbortController+8s timeout, tolerates non-OK responses (returns []), de-dupes by event|area, sorts by severity via SEV_RANK. Robust and defensive. Good.
weather.ts:82-90 expiresLabel() uses toLocaleString with 'en-US' locale which will render inconsistently in a web preview vs. RN — cosmetic only.
weather.tsx:39-48 loadAlerts uses monotonic fetchIdRef guard so late responses from a previous ZIP cannot overwrite state after the ZIP has changed. Correct.
weather.tsx:50-55 useEffect gated on lat/lon non-null starts the 60s interval only when located; cleanup clears the interval on unmount and when deps change. Correct.

weather.tsx:79-108 conditional render is correct: alerts panel ONLY when `located && alerts.length > 0`; clear-state line ONLY when `located && checked && alerts.length === 0`. Both are positioned above the MasterToggle in JSX so they render above the toggle in the ScrollView. Verified visually in screenshots.

weather.tsx:85 key = a.event + i — event alone can collide (e.g., two 'Heat Advisory'); using index i as tie-breaker is fine here. Consider using a more stable key (a.expires or NWS id from properties) if the list ever animates.
weather.tsx:57-68 onPreview correctly early-exits with an info toast when bleStatus !== 'connected'. Verified.
matrix.tsx:285-299 updateWeather persists showClock/severity/enabled to AsyncStorage and BLE-live-pushes (350ms debounce). Verified localStorage aura_settings_v1 reflects severity change.
weather.tsx uses `f.city`/`f.state` from settings.flights, matching the location badge 'Alerts for Los Angeles, CA'. Correct wiring between Flights ZIP geocode and Weather display.
No memory leaks observed: unmount cleanup clears both setInterval and the pending fetch is guarded via ref.
